integrity: The claim is supported by an exhaustive construction of all 98 nonempty faces, a complete check of all 246 Hasse covers, an acyclic 48-pair discrete-Morse matching with one critical 0-cell and one critical 2-cell, and independent boundary-rank checks over four finite fields.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact boundary example for one five-vertex graph, not a classification of all unicyclic graphs with leaves. A differently phrased or non-indexed duplicate remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: The bull-graph Morse complex is a two-sphere
